common: Use case: stylized-concept. Production concept sheet for a cozy painterly 2.5D browser RPG, Genshin-like warm golden-hour light, bright clean colors, soft brushwork, large readable volumes suitable for code-built 3D primitives and swept arches, maximum 6000 triangles. Landscape sheet about 1600x1000, ivory background, understated charcoal readable annotations. Large THREE QUARTER view on left, matching FRONT and SIDE elevations on right, clear labels. Show same canvas-clad brown-haired adventurer 1.8 blocks tall beside EACH view at correct relative scale. Dimension labels width x depth x height in blocks. Keep exact same geometry across views. Small material swatches and a few concise material labels. Do not make a montage of unrelated designs. No Minecraft voxels, no grimdark, no intricate sculpted ornament. All objects fully visible.
jobs: A compact polished BRASS ROOT PUMP, clean friendly civic machinery. White circular plinth diameter 3, four curved brass suction legs driven into soil, cylindrical central amber glass chamber, squat round brass bonnet with half sun SIX ray seal. Two large exposed parallel brass U-pipes, small handwheel. Overall height 4. Gold steady light only inside amber chamber, never teal. Field yields triple green crops beyond a DISTINCT GREY GRASS RING immediately around its plinth, show that ground ring in the perspective. Simple cylinders rings and sweeps, not steampunk clutter. Label pipes, amber chamber, grey drained ring.

The Order's clean GOLD MACHINE that sits ON the ancient High Road deck and relights one span at a time. Two white stone square support feet with a giant horizontal brass drum between, two outer upright circular brass ribs around amber cylinder, a central tall half sun seal with SIX rays, two broad curved conduits drop to the road's central channel. Simplified monument-scale primitive geometry, no tiny gears. Gold light exits ONLY to right along one channel; left channel dark. Show a small contextual deck slice not included in machine dimensions; grey grass below road as inset. Front and side elevations machine only. Friendly polished white brass amber, no teal.

Small clean white limestone square WATCH TOWER beside the lit High Road, 6 square x10 tall. Wide chamfered square base, two stories taper slightly, round arched door on front with conspicuous golden HALF SUN SIX RAY seal, narrow amber slit windows, open upper lookout with four corner posts and a shallow simple gold hipped cap. No crenellations or weapons. White plaster, limestone base, brass bands. Warm welcoming, neatly maintained, compared with rough ancient ruin stone. Gold and grey border in small base grass patch.

THE DAWN: massive golden magical HALF DOME on the NORTH HORIZON, viewed only from 400 BLOCKS OR MORE. Main view a wide atmospheric silhouette in distant blue green ridges, diameter120 blocks and chosen height60, faint city tower silhouettes INSIDE golden light. Six broad luminous shell bands with subdued seams, bright continuous soft rim. Not a solid metal building; no ornamental miniature diorama. Front and side small silhouette projections depict SAME hemisphere and CITY contained beneath, simple ghost construction lines only. Tiny hero 1.8 at foreground overlook is explicitly different distance; include another 1.8 scale tick by 120 diameter diagram. Caption '400+ blocks / distant silhouette'. Gold steady softly glowing against blue-lavender atmosphere, no teal light. Grand horizon sweep, not close-up. Distinct six bands.

Ancient round broken tower HALF SUNK into grassy slope, 8 diameter,12 visible high. Open one-room interior visible through wide round arched doorway and broken open top, one tall arched side window, jagged missing section on upper rim. Build from stacked cylinder wall segments and round arch sweeps. Pale warm limestone, lavender grey shadow, worn broad chamfers, sparse moss in joints, deliberate thick roots over lower rear wall. A simple tarnished brass open armillary ring fragment at top recalls ruin map reference but no extra roof or chamber. No gold glow. FRONT and SIDE ground lines show embedded base; optional dashed buried outline. Open sky and welcoming. Mark single room clear.

Ancient wide STONE STAIR DESCENDING into ground and STOPPING at earth. Top lies at surrounding meadow ground line, bottom 3 blocks BELOW it. Footprint6 wide10 long. About12 broad worn steps down a rectangular open-air trench with broken low retaining walls, last step meets solid earth and exposed root, NO doorway, no tunnel, no hidden entrance. Isometric cutaway clearly shows descending direction; front elevation looking down stair, SIDE SECTION of ground with fall labelled -3. Pale warm limestone lavender shadows, moss edges and thick root, round seven-point carving on broken end stone with one point chipped. Hero at upper rim and side section correct scale. Cheerful sun shafts and ferns.

A straight ancient ruined wall16 long2 thick6 high. Broad warm pale limestone face with faded ochre rust blue and muted leaf green painted mural. IMPORTANT narrative: EIGHT human-sized painted silhouettes total, a KING PLUS SEVEN COMPANIONS. Seven intact colored figures including king, and the LAST EIGHTH figure at right scraped to bare rough pale stone in clear human silhouette. No gore. Use broad flat geometric painted robe silhouettes builder can reproduce using flat planes, not detailed portraits. Match m3-friends reference sequence gardener green, healer green, judge red, admiral blue, reckoner purple, archivist white, smith charcoal, eighth removed. One end stepped broken masonry, small roots/moss at base. Front elevation clear complete full mural, side shows2 thickness. No glowing gold or teal; faded pigments only. Label 'king + seven companions / one scraped away'.

Dead garden ROOFLESS ruined cottage9x7x6. One chimney-gable wall stands tall at6; other walls broken at waist height. Entire roof absent, no rafters overhead. Empty rounded arch door frame, one small arched window in high wall, fallen broad limestone blocks inside. Pale warm limestone, lavender shadows, weathered brown door fragment flat on ground. Context small dry garden beds grey grass and broken wooden fence, exactly ONE small living green corner with flowers. Same silhouette as dead-garden reference cottage transformed roofless. No glowing magic, no gold fittings. Distinguish cottage masonry from clean Order plaster. Builder clear room footprint and standing rear gable.

Grand ancient COLONNADE:18 long6 deep8 high. One row of SIX broad plain round pale limestone columns on low grass-swallowed stylobate, four standing at different heights including two full8, two fallen into grass in FRONT within6 depth, simple round torus bases, squat square capitals. One surviving thick lintel bridges two full columns, other lintels collapsed at feet. Match ancient rounded forms and broad worn chamfers, lavender shadows cream faces sparse moss roots. Horizontal fallen drums show simple reusable cylinder sections. Tiny1.8 hero proves scale. Not elaborate Greek fluting or ruin pile. Front shows spacing, side proves depth. No gold glow.

finalCorrections: Dawn sheet and Order vista: six meridional sectors instead of horizontal stripes; remove cross finials and use half sun.
Colonnade: four upright positions and two fallen columns; two full columns share one lintel.
Mural: exactly eight silhouettes total: king healer judge admiral reckoner archivist smith and scraped Ilara. Remove erroneous extra gardener from both views and legend.
